title: When checkout slows down.
subtitle: Every second becomes an investigation.
voice: When checkout slows down, engineers need more than another alert. They need to understand what happened, what the evidence says, and what to do next.

title: Meet SentinelOps AI.
subtitle: From signal to a confident next decision.
voice: Meet SentinelOps AI. An incident investigation prototype built around one focused workflow: investigate a slow PostgreSQL checkout query, propose a repair, and keep a human in control.

title: One calm command center.
subtitle: Incidents. Evidence. Decisions.
voice: Start in a clean workspace. See the incident that needs attention, open its details, and follow the investigation. This product walkthrough uses a clearly labelled sample workspace.

title: Follow the evidence.
subtitle: Metrics + query plans + schema context.
voice: Connect the performance signal with the query plan and schema. Inspect observations and supporting evidence before considering the proposed index repair. The goal is a decision you can explain.

title: Human approval comes first.
subtitle: Review the proposal. Decide what happens next.
voice: A proposal is not permission. Review the repair and its risks, then approve or reject. Sample dashboard decisions are previews. Real execution goes through the local command line approval gate.

title: Verify recovery. Protect results.
subtitle: Measure before and after. Roll back on failure.
voice: The backend checks performance before and after the allowlisted repair, and verifies that query results stay identical. Database integration tests cover recovery and rollback using a deterministic model stand in.

title: Clarity after the incident.
subtitle: A readable timeline. A shareable report.
voice: Explore the recorded timeline and evidence citation coverage. Export the report so others can review the observations and decisions. These analytics describe a loaded incident snapshot, not a live monitoring feed.

title: Evidence before action.
subtitle: SentinelOps AI · neatHack prototype
voice: SentinelOps AI. Evidence before action. Human control by design. The prototype is ready to explore; live model and account flows still need separate verification.
